description: Enhanced boundary coverage for seconds-resolution epoch round-tripping (disjoint from native cases). Covers the epoch origin (zero), a negative pre-1970 fractional epoch (sub-second borrow), a whole-second epoch with zero millisecond component, and a far-future near-max epoch where float seconds precision yields 998ms; encoding covers the origin, a whole-second instant (integer-valued epoch), a sub-second positive instant, and a negative pre-1970 instant.
